# Agent Guide

> Environment-bound guide, skills and llms.txt for operating this AppThrust Project. Project work uses apth alone: the Platform API and a login, no kubeconfig. apthctl pages are for operators holding a kubeconfig issued for this environment.

## Start here

- [Start here](https://agent-guide.pj-test.example.test/md/start-here.md): Choose a track for this Project.

## apth

- [Install apth](https://agent-guide.pj-test.example.test/md/apth/install.md): Install the developer CLI.
- [Log in](https://agent-guide.pj-test.example.test/md/apth/login.md): Select your Project.

## Skills

- [example](https://agent-guide.pj-test.example.test/skills/example/SKILL.md): Operate this Project.
